
            <div class="postcontent">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="mp-md" style="-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-autospace: normal; text-align: left; color: rgba(92, 97, 102, 1); background-color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Roboto, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; padding: 1.5em 1em"><p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在数据工程和办公自动化场景中，读取 Excel 文件前通常需要先获取其工作表清单，以便了解文件结构、确定数据所在位置，或批量遍历多表执行统一处理。本文介绍如何使用 Free Spire.XLS for Python 免费库完成这一操作。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">环境准备</span></h2>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-bash" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">pip install Spire.Xls.Free
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">该库支持 .xls（Excel 97-2003）和 .xlsx（Excel 2007+）两种格式，无需安装 Microsoft Office。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">获取所有工作表名称</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">核心 API 非常简单：</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Workbook.Worksheets</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 是一个工作表集合，遍历即可；每个 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Worksheet</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 对象通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">.Name</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 属性返回其名称。</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 创建 Workbook 实例并加载文件</span><br>
workbook = Workbook()<br>
workbook.LoadFromFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"测试.xlsx"</span>)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 遍历所有工作表，输出名称</span><br>
names = []<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> sheet <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> workbook.Worksheets:<br>
names.append(sheet.Name)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">print</span>(names)  <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 例如：['报告', '目标对比', '实际完成', '总结', '备注']</span></p>
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">workbook.Dispose()<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Worksheets</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 集合包含工作簿中所有工作表，包括隐藏的工作表。如果只需要名称列表，可以用列表推导式进一步简化：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">names = [sheet.Name <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> sheet <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> workbook.Worksheets]
</code></pre>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">仅获取隐藏工作表的名称</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">某些场景下需要单独处理隐藏工作表，例如审计文件结构或恢复误隐藏的数据表。通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Worksheet.Visibility</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 属性可以判断工作表是否为隐藏状态，该属性与 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">WorksheetVisibility.Hidden</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 枚举值比较即可。</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<p>workbook = Workbook()<br>
workbook.LoadFromFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"测试.xlsx"</span>)</p>
<p>hidden_names = [<br>
sheet.Name<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> sheet <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> workbook.Worksheets<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> sheet.Visibility == WorksheetVisibility.Hidden<br>
]</p>
<p><span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">print</span>(hidden_names)  <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 例如：['总结', '备注']</span></p>
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">workbook.Dispose()<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">免费版限制说明</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Free Spire.XLS for Python 在功能上足够完成工作表名称读取等基础操作，但需要注意其免费版的边界：对 .xls 格式的读写，每个工作簿最多支持 5 个工作表、每个工作表最多 200 行；如果处理 .xlsx 格式，则不触发这一限制。对于工作表数量较多的大型文件，建议优先使用 .xlsx 格式。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">资源管理</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">使用完 Workbook 对象后，建议显式调用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">workbook.Dispose()</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 释放内存资源，尤其在批量处理多个文件时，这一点尤为重要。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">与其他方案的简单对比</span></h2>
<figure class="figure-table" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; text-align: center; overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch"><table style="box-sizing: border-box; display: table; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); font-weight: bold; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); text-align: center; min-width: 6em"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">获取表名方式</span></th><th style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); font-weight: bold; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); text-align: center; min-width: 6em"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">安装体积</span></th><th style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Free Spire.XLS</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">for sheet in workbook.Worksheets</code></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">中等</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">否</span></td></tr><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background-color: rgba(250, 250, 250, 1)"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">openpyxl</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">wb.sheetnames</code></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">轻量</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">否</span></td></tr><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">pandas</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">pd.ExcelFile(path).sheet_names</code></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">较重（含 numpy 依赖）</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">否</span></td></tr></tbody></table></figure>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">如果项目中已经使用了 pandas 进行数据分析，直接用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">pd.ExcelFile().sheet_names</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 是最省事的方案；openpyxl 在纯读取表名时性能不错。Free Spire.XLS 的优势在于它同时覆盖读写和格式操作，如果后续需要对工作表进行重命名、复制或格式调整，可以沿用同一套 API，减少依赖切换。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">小结</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">提取 Excel 工作表名称是一个轻量但高频的操作。Free Spire.XLS for Python 通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Worksheet.Name</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 和 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Worksheet.Visibility</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 两个属性，分别覆盖了“获取全部表名”和“筛选隐藏表名”两种常见需求，代码量极少。在实际工程中，建议结合项目已有的 Excel 处理方案选择工具，避免引入不必要的依赖。</span></p></section>
